headline: The Nile Theater, Mesa AZ

travel.title: Fly
travel.description: PHX Sky Harbor · 15 min rideshare to venue.

travel.title: Stay
travel.description:
Nearby hotels listed for your convenience:
- Travelodge by Wyndham Mesa — closest budget option, about 0.3 miles away.
- Knights Inn Mesa — about 0.6 miles away, very close but more basic.
- Delta Hotels by Marriott Phoenix Mesa — about 0.7 miles away, best overall option and the one I’d recommend publicly.

travel.title: Drive
travel.description: Parking is available behind The Nile Theater, along nearby open street parking, and in public

travel.title: Light Rail
travel.description: The Nile Theater is easily accessible by Valley Metro light rail, with the Center/Main Street stop just a short walk from the venue.

description: A century-old art-deco shell gutted into a three-stage sound labyrinth — main hall, coffee shop, and basement. Walls that sweat. A roof that trembles. Located on Main Street, Mesa — 20 minutes east of downtown Phoenix.
